answer: Because your offer was issued on January 28, before February 1, 2026, it keeps the original terms of 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, not the newer 5-day limit. Seven days from January 28 reaches February 4, but check the exact expiration date on your offer page or in your confirmation email. We honor the offer if your appraisal appointment is on or before that date and you haven't driven more than 300 additional miles. If it does expire, you can request a new offer at any time, though the amount may be higher or lower.
